title: A page's URL grammar is spelled in four places: declare it once, derive the rest

body:
## Summary
Each page's nested URL grammar is restated in four independent places - the Layer2 positional parser, the breadcrumb label switch in index.ts, the shell's RISE_DEPTH hand-list, and every link builder on other pages. Declare it once as a route schema the page module exports, and derive parse, labels, rise depth, canonicalisation and typed link builders from it. Brain, the most cross-linked page, is the pilot; the schema type is general and characters/routes.ts already proves the shape.

## Description
Leans on app-shell / navigation-model: 'the discipline covers every level the shell can name, not just the top' and 'deep links resolve through the same door ... an unrecognized address degrades to a defined fallback'. Today the router owns only the page-id vocabulary (route.ts:7); below it, `sub` is a string[] every consumer reinterprets. The drift is already live: Brain's own run list links `t/r` (Runs.tsx:19) while On Air, Reconcile, Simulator and Characters link a bare run id (RunDetail.tsx:58,80 drops a tournamentId it holds), and the daemon refuses a bare id that exists in two tournaments (runs.rs:173). Run ids are deterministic per matrix cell (matrix.rs:184), so re-running a tournament makes On Air's transcript links ambiguous.

The move: `router/schema.ts` defines a small segment tree (literal | param, optional label fn, `rise` marker) with `matchSub`, `labelOf` and a typed builder. PageModule gets `routes?`. The shell derives riseKey and crumb labels from it (falling back to RISE_DEPTH / `label` for undeclared pages, so migration is page by page) and replace-navigates an unmatched sub to its deepest valid prefix. `pages/brain/routes.ts` declares engine | transcripts[/:run[/:line]] | preflight and exports `transcriptRoute({tournamentId?, runId}, line?)`, which qualifies whenever the caller knows the tournament; the five cross-page call sites switch to it.

## Flow
- Add schema.ts + tests (pure, no consumers).
- PageModule.routes optional; Shell labelFor/riseKey prefer it; unmatched sub -> replace to fallback.
- brain/routes.ts declares the grammar; brain/index.ts drops brainLabel; Layer2 reads params from matchSub.
- onair/RunDetail, onair/Layer1, reconcile/Refs, simulator/common, characters/SituationsTab call transcriptRoute.

## Expected impact
One place states Brain's URL; renaming a floor or adding a param breaks typecheck at every link instead of silently landing on an EmptyState. On Air transcript links stop hitting the daemon's ambiguity error. The other six pages migrate by declaring a schema, and RISE_DEPTH shrinks to nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: a declared route schema removes three restatements of Brain's grammar and fixes bare-run transcript links.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no schema module, no transcriptRoute, #/brain/nonsense renders an EmptyState, RunDetail links bare ids, 6 hand-built cross-page transcript routes)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence: brain/Layer2.tsx:43 `const [floor, run, line] = sub;` | brain/index.ts:15-17 `if (parts[1] === "transcripts" && depth === 2) return segment; ... depth === 3) return `Line ${segment}`` | rise.ts:14-15 `// <floor> / <run>; the line is a scroll target in the transcript` / `brain: 2,` | Runs.tsx:19 `export const qualifiedRun = (r: RunRow): string => `${r.tournament_id}/${r.run_id}`;` | RunDetail.tsx:58 `<RouteLink to={pageRoute("brain", "transcripts", runId)}` and :93 `useRpc("run.transcript", { run_id: runId, tournament_id: tournamentId })` | runs.rs:156-158 `match run_ref.split_once('/') { Some((t, r)) => (Some(t), r), None => (tournament_id, run_ref) }` and :173-174 `"run id {rid} is in {} tournaments ({}); use <tournament_id>/<run_id>"` | grep `pageRoute("brain", "transcripts"` non-test: brain/Layer1.tsx:28, brain/Runs.tsx:26,84, brain/Viewer.tsx:94, characters/SituationsTab.tsx:222, onair/Layer1.tsx:127, onair/RunDetail.tsx:58,80, reconcile/Refs.tsx:18, simulator/common.tsx:27 | `grep -rn 'pageRoute(' pages app | grep -v test | wc -l` -> 82

critic.reason: Sound architecture move with a concrete user-visible bug as its proof.

body:
## Summary
The operator reads run#line refs, segment ids and console links everywhere - reconcile reports, verdicts, chat, CLI output - but the console has no way to accept one. Getting to a transcript line takes five moves through the wall, a tab, a list and a pick. Ctrl+K opens a one-field Go to overlay that resolves a pasted ref/hash/segment id, page names and the places visited this session; Enter lands there.

## Description
Leans on app-shell's golden path ('the shell never unmounts ... the only legitimate home for ... command palettes') and navigation-model ('the palette searches [the registry]', 'deep links resolve through the same door'). goto.ts is pure: `resolveQuery(q, recents)` tries, in order, decodeRoute on a hash or URL-with-hash, parseRef on `<run>#<line>` (qualified `t/r#n` kept as one segment), a SEG-id pattern, then fuzzy page matches over POSTERS and recents labelled by crumbs(). Recents are a reducer over route changes (dedupe, newest first, cap 8, wall excluded) held in Shell state - not persisted, so nothing new is stored. GoTo.tsx mounts only while open (DOM budget untouched), owns its keys (arrows/Enter/Escape preventDefault so the global listener skips them, listener.ts:20) and navigates through router.navigate, the one write door. Chrome gets a 'Go to - Ctrl K' button for pointer users.

## Flow
- keymap: `{chord:'Ctrl+k', modes: wall/l1/l2, action:{type:'goto'}}`.
- keyActions: goto -> {kind:'open-goto'}; Shell sets open state.
- GoTo: input + candidate listbox (aria-activedescendant); Enter -> navigate -> close -> focus returns to spread/poster.
- Recents update from useRoute in Shell.

## Expected impact
A ref copied from anywhere opens at its line in one keystroke plus a paste; 'back to where I was two pages ago' becomes Ctrl+K, Enter. No new data is fetched or stored.

## Evaluation
Claim: one overlay turns a five-move navigation into one, for refs, links, segment ids and recent places.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (no goto binding, no resolver, no overlay)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first
Result: better
Gate: none
